title: How To Add or Edit Categories For Post Types
text:
## How To Add or Edit Categories For Post Types
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000001792
Post Types come with pre-set, example categories:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145378705/original/jVD9H0b1zHYjxvZsWUCb1u-xkrtbiGonAQ.png?1719331795 | alt: ]
These will need to be replaced with actual categories or deleted to remove the post category option from the post form. This field has a limit of 999 characters.

## Edit Post Categories
Locate The Post Type
1. Go to My Content > Edit Post Settings
2. Locate the desired post type to edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12130491570/original/rRAvP4ydNr2t5YHXcxlvyV4MNktZCyfb6w.png?1693241327 | alt: ]
Edit The Categories
1. Look for the Post Categorie s field
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12130495744/original/mb-TKPe9LcTLRttsWPIc-XBm6EYpybnYrQ.png?1693245708 | alt: ]
No spaces
No special characters
It's possible to have the first category appear blank on the members drop-down box, and add a "," in front of the first category to achieve this.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12104720578/original/FGVsxmomLfU4MjVjeziUWg4yzDR-nlluWA.png?1644255715 | alt: ]
Note: The allowed characters for Post Categories are letters, numbers, periods, and apostrophes.
If this is not an option on the site, please check the Software Updates module, which is located on the Dashboard:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089662821/original/gky9PuJBqQ6PmvXt6SnRBg9weYvzo4pxsQ.png?1615056368 | alt: ]

## Applicable Post Types
These steps apply to the following post types:
Article
Article
Audio File
Audio File
Classified
Classified
Coupon
Coupon

Discussion

Event

Job Opening

Photo Album
Product
Product

Video
Website - Digital Product
Website - Digital Product
Website Blog Article
Website Blog Article

## Exception: Properties Post Type
The Properties post type does not have a Post Category field in Edit Post Settings . Instead, it uses different classification fields such as Property Status and Property Type . These fields can be edited directly in the Feature - Properties form within the Form Manager.
For more details, refer to the  following documentation:
How to Update Property Types Using the Form Manager
